 CORAM : SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.
DATE : 13th JUNE, 2024 P.C. :
1.
This Writ Petition is sent through jail by the Petitioner.
The prayer in the Petition is for directions to the trial Court to complete the trial in a time bound manner.
2. Learned counsel for the Petitioner states that the said Petition mentions that since framing of the charges, no witnesses are yet examined.
In this case the investigation is of the year 2019 pertaining to C.R. No.14/2019 of Wada police station.
The offences alleged are under Sections 376, 1 of 2 Deshmane(PS) :2: 7.wp-3408-23.odt 506 of IPC and under Sections of 4, 6, 8 & 12 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
